description: Search U.S. electric utilities and retail providers by name or initials (e.g. 'PG&E', 'Oncor', 'Duke Energy') and return each one's average residential price per kWh and customer count from EIA Form 861. These are what residential customers paid on average over the year, not current plan offers.

state.description: Optional: limit to one state (code or name).

name: find_utility_rate
title: Look up an electric utility's average rate
